groups.name: maze
groups.method: CPU VM with native gameplay/serialization/validation. Synthetic player positioning, forced HP-zero deaths, invulnerability; DOM/Image/audio/timers and renderer-readiness spy. NOT browser/GPU/natural play.

groups.name: cold
groups.method: Independent new Node process. Native save validation/restoration, native pathfinding and wound tick; synthetic fixtures, renderer readiness spy, disabled enemy AI. NOT browser/GPU/natural play.

groups.name: ego-regression
groups.method: CPU VM with synthetic EGO active visit validated by native restore. DOM, image, audio, renderer readiness stubbed. Not browser/GPU.

groups.name: champion
groups.method: Native hospital restore, difficulty choice/reapplication, actor scaling and save round trips in Node VM. No browser/GPU/natural play.

groups.name: migration
groups.method: Native CPU VM importing actual v1 test checkpoint fixtures into v2, without browser/GPU.

groups.name: layout
groups.method: Native layout, A5 masonry plan, native analytical swept wall collision, and grid flood reachability in Node VM. DOM/Image/audio/timers are stubs. boot() and renderer readiness spy were NOT invoked. Not browser input, image rendering, WebGL/GPU or natural-play verification.

groups.name: roof
groups.method: Pinned Three r186 BufferGeometry, Group and material objects under Node, without WebGL renderer. Actual GPU/pixel rendering is unverified.

groups.name: package
groups.method: Node syntax, complete manifest SHA256 verification, actual loopback HTTP. No browser/GPU/audio playback or natural input.

limits: DOM, images, audio, timers and Three readiness are stubbed for gameplay CPU tests. Player teleporting, invulnerability and forced enemy deaths assist progression tests.
Roof checks instantiate actual pinned Three r186 geometry/materials in Node, without a WebGL renderer. They cannot validate pixels, GPU performance or real-input feel.
EGO coverage uses an old no-metadata fixture plus three repeated saves; it does not cover every historical schema or visit multiplier.
V1 save migration covers the actual previous test build rally and boss checkpoints, not every possible user save.
